narrative.overview: Blackened walnut, worn antique brass, oxblood plates and bone lettering surround the real Gunblood imagery. Readable HTML carries controls, codes, status and attribution.

rules.name: The Material Color Rule
rules.body: Use the production raster materials as the visual source for wood, brass and plates.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Reserve decorative Western lettering for the brand, headings and main actions.

dos: Do retain keyboard focus and reduced-motion adaptation.
Do keep asset provenance beside production artwork.
donts: Don't return to the rejected plain cream treatment.
Don't bake functional copy into generated artwork.
Don't describe the failed automated comparison as passed.
